flashcard_questions.q: Where in the world are tropical rainforests found?
flashcard_questions.a: In a belt around the equator, mostly within 10° of it.

flashcard_questions.q: What share of the Earth's land surface do tropical rainforests cover?
What share of the world's plant and animal species live in tropical rainforests?
What is the typical temperature range in a tropical rainforest?
How much rain falls in a tropical rainforest each year?
How long is the growing season in a tropical rainforest?
Which rainforest layer rises above 40 m?
What share of sunlight reaches the rainforest floor?

flashcard_questions.a: A thin, infertile tropical soil that lacks nutrients.

flashcard_questions.q: Why is rainforest soil so poor despite the lush vegetation?
flashcard_questions.a: Roots reabsorb nutrients quickly and heavy rain leaches away the rest.

flashcard_questions.q: Which condition are drip tip leaves an adaptation to?
Why do emergent trees need buttress roots?
flashcard_questions.a: They support trees over 50 m tall competing for sunlight.

flashcard_questions.q: Why do rainforest trees have thin, smooth bark?
flashcard_questions.a: It stops epiphytes taking hold and stealing light and nutrients.

flashcard_questions.q: How does the toucan's beak suit feeding in the canopy?
flashcard_questions.a: It is long and lightweight for reaching and breaking apart fruit.

flashcard_questions.q: How can a green anaconda breathe while lying in wait underwater?
flashcard_questions.a: Its eyes and nostrils sit on top of its head.

notes: 15 cards: 6 case-study-to-fact with one figure each (6% of land, 50-90% of species, 25-30°C, 2,000-3,000 mm, 12-month growing season, 2% of light), 2 term-to-definition (latosol, emergent layer), 2 process-to-effect (nutrient cycling, distribution), 5 adaptation cards linking a feature to the condition it beats (drip tips, buttress roots, smooth bark, toucan beak, anaconda eyes). Dropped the lianas and leaf-cutter ant detail; left out the exam-technique key fact because revision advice is not flashcard content.
